newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NAIL DETAILS ONE BLN RAND RIGHTS OFFER.
newsitem.headline: NAIL DETAILS ONE BLN RAND RIGHTS OFFER.

text.p: New Africa Investments Ltd said on Tuesday South African institutions had undertaken to take up more than one billion rand in new Nail N-shares at 315 cents each.

Nail said its rights offer would open on August 22 and close on September 12 for shareholders registered on August 15. Letters of allocation would be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange from August 18 to September 10.

"This is a gratifying endorsement. We are confident that many previously disadvantaged groups and individuals will follow the example of professional investors," chairman Nthato Motlana said in a statement.
Nail shareholders would be offered 75 new N-shares for every 100 held. The N-shares are being offered at a discount of 11 percent to net asset value.
It said 326 million rand of the cash raised would be used to increase its stake in Metropolitana Life Ltd to 21.2 percent. Nail has an option to increase it to 8.2 percent.
Some 166 million rand would be used to increase Nail's shareholding in African Merchant Bank (AMB) to 49 percent, 176 million rand to increase the capital of AMB and 82 million rand to repay debt.
The balance of 250 million rand would be used to fund increased holdings in Mobile Telephone Networks Holdings (Pty) Ltd, Sowetan newspaper, Radio Jacaranda and to cover costs.
